summary: 美食作家谢拉顿讲述如何从全球菜肴中选出一千种，并按风味和烹饪传统编排。寻找一道菜的过程也能认识当地人的生活。
logic: 从奇特菜肴引出一份美食清单
怎样选出一千项世界美食
按风味编排，跟着食物去旅行
从食物认识人、地方与习俗

paragraphs.brief: 不过，前《纽约时报》餐饮评论家、《史密森尼》杂志撰稿人米米·谢拉顿推出了新书《一生必尝的 1,000 种食物》，这会让美食爱好者的必尝清单一下子长出许多。
sentences: When was the last time you sat down to a meal of hamam meshwi, a.k.a. grilled pigeon, which is most likely found on a menu in Egypt?
你最后一次坐下来吃一顿烤鸽子很可能是在埃及的菜单上？
Or traveled to Oslo, Norway, for a breakfast of freshly caught shrimp?
还是去挪威奥斯陆吃新鲜捕虾的早餐？
Chances are probably never.
机会可能永远不会。

However, thanks to former New York Times restaurant critic, Smithsonian contributor, and author Mimi Sheraton’s latest book, 1,000 Foods to Eat Before You Die, your foodie life list is about to get a whole lot longer.
不过，前《纽约时报》餐饮评论家、《史密森尼》杂志撰稿人米米·谢拉顿推出了新书《一生必尝的 1,000 种食物》，这会让美食爱好者的必尝清单一下子长出许多。

paragraphs.brief: 谢拉顿以帕特里西亚·舒尔茨的最销的标题"1000个地方见到你死之前"为灵感，(这也由Workman出版社发行)，谢拉顿已经收集了1000个必须尝试的菜式，餐厅，市场，文化节日，甚至一些相对普遍的食物 (如香，橄油和鞭奶油)
sentences: Inspired by Patricia Schultz’s best-selling title, 1,000 Places to See Before You Die (which is also distributed by Workman Publishing), Sheraton has rounded up 1,000 must-try dishes, restaurants, markets, cultural feasts, and even some relatively universal foods (such as bananas, olive oil, and whipped cream) that transcend regional categorization.
谢拉顿以帕特里西亚·舒尔茨的最销的标题"1000个地方见到你死之前"为灵感，(这也由Workman出版社发行)，谢拉顿已经收集了1000个必须尝试的菜式，餐厅，市场，文化节日，甚至一些相对普遍的食物 (如香，橄油和鞭奶油)

Curated from cuisines around the globe, Sheraton has put them together in one large volume, along with details on historic and cultural context, tips on how to prepare or where to try a particular dish, and even several dozen recipes.
喜来登从全球的烹饪中总结出来，整理成一大批，以及历史和文化背景的细节，关于如何准备或在哪里尝试某一种菜，甚至几十种食谱。

It’s a project that’s been 10 years in the making—one that’s as much a wonderful display of Sheraton’s vast food knowledge (she’s been writing about food for 60 years) as it is an ode to the world’s sheer culinary diversity.
这个项目已经制作了十年了，这也是喜来登丰富的食物知识的精彩展示(她写了60年的食物知识)，同时也是世界烹饪多样性的一幅剧。

paragraphs.brief: 正如《一生必去的 1,000 个地方》为旅行读物开辟了新路，《一生必尝的 1,000 种食物》也列出了一份让人垂涎的世界美食清单，内容丰富、赏心悦目，又充满乐趣。
sentences: The ultimate gift for the food lover.
给爱食者的终极礼物

In the same way that 1,000 Places to See Before You Die reinvented the travel book, 1,000 Foods to Eat Before You Die is a joyous, informative, dazzling, mouthwatering life list of the world’s best food.
正如《一生必去的 1,000 个地方》为旅行读物开辟了新路，《一生必尝的 1,000 种食物》也列出了一份让人垂涎的世界美食清单，内容丰富、赏心悦目，又充满乐趣。

paragraphs.brief: 将世界不可思议的事物融入到1000个条目中并非小事。
sentences: Fitting the world’s incredible eats into a mere 1,000 entries, however, is no small task.
将世界不可思议的事物融入到1000个条目中并非小事。
“I actually started with about 1,800 entries that I had to weed down,” says Sheraton.
喜来登说：“我从大约1800个条目开始，我不得不将它除草。”
“All the while, other foods and dishes continued presenting themselves.”
“在这段时间里，其他食物和盘子继续呈现出来。”
One of her main goals was showing an equal respect for the dishes of, say, Australia, as she did for a culinary powerhouse like China.
她的主要目标之一是对澳大利亚的菜盘表现出同样的尊重，就像她对中国这样的烹饪家所做的那样。
“Between the United States, France and Italy, I could have easily filled the book,” she says, “but I wanted to give an overall representation of what the world eats.
她说，“但是我想给出一个整体代表世界的饮食：“在美国、法国和意大利之间，我本可以很容易地填满这本书。”

There are interesting things to try before you die in all parts of the world, so chicken pot pie and strawberry shortcake fell by the wayside to make room for something like East Africa’s Zanzibar duck,” a braised, clove-scented duck seasoned with lemon.
在你死之前，世界各地都有一些有趣的事情需要尝试，所以鸡肉馅饼和草莓小蛋糕都掉到路边，让东非的桑给巴尔鸭子这样的东西有空间。“一只有柠檬味的勃勃和丁香的鸭子。

paragraphs.brief: 有些条目将食品组合在一起，例如喜来登在《西班牙奶酪》和《Rijstatfel》上写的文章，这是在荷兰殖民主义时代发生的一系列印度尼西亚大米餐。
sentences: Nearly the same number of pages as it has entries, 1,000 Foods highlights everything from Chinese hai xian jiang (known in the U.S. as hoisin sauce) to the oysters of Locmariaquer, France.
近乎相同数量的页面，1000份食品突显了从中国海扁江(在美国被称为海辛酱)到法国洛克马里亚奎尔牡蛎的所有事物。

Staples of the dinner table such as pasta run alongside more specific items like the “golden-edged” crêpes at Manhattan patisserie Lady M, while other entries focus on iconic restaurants such as Nairobi, Kenya’s Carnivore, known for its unusual variety of meats (things like camel hump, ox heart, or ostrich meatballs), or on food-inspired cinema such as the 1989 dark comedy, The Cook, the Thief, His Wife, and Her Lover.
餐桌的订书，如意大利面，与曼哈顿Patisserie Lady M的“金字塔”等更具体的项目一起运行，而其他专栏则侧重于标志性餐馆，如内罗毕、肯尼亚的卡尼沃尔(以其异乎寻常的肉类品种闻名)(骆驼、牛心或食肉丸等)，或1989年的黑暗喜剧《厨师》、《小偷》、《他的妻子》和《爱人》等。
There’s no particular rhyme or reason as to why a food hall may be one entry and Belgium’s Callebaut chocolate another, other than simply—it fits.
没有特别的押韵和理由说明为什么一个食品厅可能是一个入口比利时的卡列布巧克力是另一个除了简单 -它适合

“While there are exactly 1,000 entries, there are actually many more foods, because I found the only way to include something that didn’t require a lot of text for itself, but was important in a larger context, was to group it,” says Sheraton.
但在更广泛的背景下，这是一个重要因素：“虽然有1000个入口，但实际上还有更多的食物，因为我发现唯一的方法是包含一些不需要大量的文字的东西。”
Some entries group foods together, such as Sheraton’s write-up on “Spanish Cheeses” and “Rijsttafel,” an array of Indonesian rice table feasts that came about during the age of Dutch colonialism.
有些条目将食品组合在一起，例如喜来登在《西班牙奶酪》和《Rijstatfel》上写的文章，这是在荷兰殖民主义时代发生的一系列印度尼西亚大米餐。

paragraphs.brief: 谢拉顿组织了1000种食品，根据口味和风格的地理位置而不是严格的地理边界，所以糖果在区域标题"美国和加拿大"下列，而菜则在标题"德国，奥地利和瑞士"的部分中找到。
sentences: Sheraton organized 1,000 Foods according to the geography of flavor and culinary style rather than strict geographical borders, so candied apples are listed under the regional heading “American and Canadian” while leberwurst is found in the section titled “German, Austrian, and Swiss.”
谢拉顿组织了1000种食品，根据口味和风格的地理位置而不是严格的地理边界，所以糖果在区域标题"美国和加拿大"下列，而菜则在标题"德国，奥地利和瑞士"的部分中找到。
For the most part, traditional dishes that may be popular internationally are still listed according to their region of origin.
多数情况下，可能在国际上流行的传统菜菜仍然按其原产地列出。
For example, a food such as pizza, despite being an American staple, still falls under “Italy.”
例如，比萨饼等食品尽管是美国主食，但仍属于“意大利”之列。
Likewise, the American Chinese dish chow mein is found in the book’s “Chinese” chapter, although it’s much more popular in the States.
虽然在美国更受欢迎：“同样地，美国中国菜的鱼肉在这本书的“中国”章节中找到。”
This can be a bit confusing at first, but once you get the hang of it, it becomes easy to navigate.
一开始可能会有点混乱但一旦你掌握了它很容易航行

Along with a general index, there’s also a special index providing easy access to items such as holiday food, world-class markets, and recipes, the latter of which there are about 70 scattered throughout.
与一般指数一样，还有一种特别指数，方便人们获得节日食品、世界级市场和食谱等物品，后者有大约70种分散在各地。
But perhaps the book’s most helpful perk is that each listing contains information highlighting ways you can actually experience the food, place, etc., yourself.
但书中最有用的好处是，每张列表都包含一些信息，突显出您可以实际体验食物、地点等等的方式。
“Everything in the book has to be available to readers somehow,” she says, “whether you go to a restaurant or buy it at a store or online or even make it yourself, everything there is triable.”
她说，“书中的一切东西都必须以某种方式提供给读者，”“不管你到餐馆或在商店或网上买，还是自己做，那里的一切都是可以审案的。”

paragraphs.brief: 美食与旅行之间的联系毋庸置疑，《一生必尝的 1,000 种食物》既是一趟美食之旅，也是对世界及其居民的探索。
sentences: Since the connection between food and travel is undeniable, 1,000 Foods is as much an exploration of the world and its people as it is a culinary journey.
美食与旅行之间的联系毋庸置疑，《一生必尝的 1,000 种食物》既是一趟美食之旅，也是对世界及其居民的探索。
“For me, food helps define a place,” says Sheraton.
谢拉顿说：“对我来说，食物有助于体现一个地方的特色。”
“Not only does it put me closer in touch with the people who are preparing the food, but I also experience the way it is served, the different flavors, etc.
不仅让我更接近与正在准备食物的人，而且，我还体验如何使用它，不同的口味，等等。

I really think that in a world that’s becoming more homogenous if you can find traditional foods in their country of origin—like Ukrainian borscht in Kiev, or hairy crab in Shanghai— it’s as important as looking at a cathedral or some statue.”
我真的认为，在这样一个世界里，如果你能在原籍国找到传统的食物 — — 比如基辅的乌克兰肉食，或者上海的毛蟹 — — 就会变得更加同质 — — 这与看大教堂或雕像同样重要。

paragraphs.brief: 事实上，喜来登说，除了食物之外，还有其他很多东西可以从食物中找到。
sentences: In truth, says Sheraton, there’s a lot other than food you can find out about from food.
事实上，喜来登说，除了食物之外，还有其他很多东西可以从食物中找到。
Turns out 1,000 Foods is the perfect tool.
事实证明，1000食品是完美的工具。
Despite its tagline, Sheraton’s book is much more than a food lover’s life list.
喜来登的书尽管有标签，但远不止是食物爱好者的人生清单。

“There are so many ways to use 1,000 Foods,” she says, “whether you’re planning to visit a place and want to look up dishes to try while there, or if you’re so dedicated you want to find a very unusual dish to try, so you start from the entry and then travel to the place it suggests.
”她说，“有许多方法可以使用1000种食品，“不管你打算到一个地方看菜，在那个地方试吃，还是你这么热心，想找到一种非常不寻常的菜来试吃，所以你从入口开始，然后去它建议的地方。

As a writer, I hope that most people will simply find it to be a good read: dip in and out and maybe strike up an interest that will lead them even further into a certain cuisine or country or customs.”
作为一名作家，我希望大多数人会发现它只是一个很好的读物：跳进和跳出，或许会激发一种兴趣，使他们进一步进入某种烹饪或国家或习俗。

paragraphs.brief: 喜来登自己在写这本书时学会了新事实发现了新食物这正是她说的让她走了很多路
sentences: Sheraton herself learned new facts and discovered new foods while writing the book, which is what she says kept her going in a lot of ways.
喜来登自己在写这本书时学会了新事实发现了新食物这正是她说的让她走了很多路
Based on her research she predicts that there are a few African cuisines—namely Senegalese and Ethiopian—that will have much wider influence as Western palates expand.
根据她的研究结果，她预测，随着西方的面貌的扩大，一些非洲菜——即塞内加尔菜和埃塞俄比亚菜——将具有更广泛的影响。
She also sees a trend toward more western Mediterranean cuisine, which, simply put, utilizes more spices, while its eastern counterpart focuses on herbs.
她还看到一种趋势，即西地中海美食增加，简单地说，它利用更多的香料，而东地中海的香料则侧重于草药。

paragraphs.brief: 虽然喜来登尝到了所列条目的绝大多数，但仍有一些出于某种原因未能达到目的(但根据她可行的、可信赖的来源，不能将之排除在外)。
sentences: While Sheraton has tasted the overall majority of entries listed, there are still a few that for one reason or another have eluded her (but that, according to her viable, trusted sources, cannot be left out).
虽然喜来登尝到了所列条目的绝大多数，但仍有一些出于某种原因未能达到目的(但根据她可行的、可信赖的来源，不能将之排除在外)。
“As I say in the book’s intro, my reach has always exceeded my grasp.
“正如我在书的内幕中所言，我的能力总是超出我的能力。
But that’s okay,” she says, “because it gives me something to look forward to.”
”她说，“因为这给了我期待的东西。

lead: Written by a former New York Times restaurant critic, this tome will keep your appetite satisfied for a lifetime.
这本厚厚的美食指南出自《纽约时报》前餐厅评论家之手，书里的美味足够让人吃上一辈子。
